body_html:
#poemsofpresence
#smallpoems
Ferns unfurl
fast across
forest floors
spores of
   fiddleheads
scores of glistening
      beds
no flowers found
in such beauty
Like a child
  overlooked
Art in
    stasis
fossilized history
   of uninformed
possibility
